newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Brent March rebounds after hitting new low.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Brent March rebounds after hitting new low.

text.p: Brent March crude futures reversed earlier declines by late afternoon trading as the fall to a fresh low in the latest downtrend prompted some bargain hunting.
March Brent was last traded at $20.58 per barrel in late trading, up six cents from London's overnight settlement.
Earlier it dropped to $20.35, the lowest level since late August for the front-month position.
Brokers attributed the earlier decline to selling pressure from a major on the April position and March/April spread.
April was sold down to $20.00 but has since rebounded to last trade at $20.25, up one cent from London.
A broker said the market remained in a downtrend, but the sudden fall earlier had sparked some interest to buy the market back.
"The trend is still looking down," he said.
NYMEX March crude was also slightly firmer, last trading at $21.90, up four cents from overnight New York.
